facts.big: Could you tell me how much it is?
facts.label: how much / how many
facts.sub: Use Could you tell me + how much / how many + sujeito + verbo. Depois de how much, a ordem é normal: it is, they cost, não is it, do they cost.

facts.label: quanto
facts.sub: Use Could you tell me how much it is? para preço. Depois de how much, a ordem é normal: it is. Para itens no plural, diga how much they are.

facts.label: quantos
facts.sub: Use how many com coisas que você conta: Could you tell me how many colors you have? Depois, sujeito e verbo: you have.

pages.title: A clothes shop · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a hot Saturday afternoon in a big shop in Dallas. A sign on the door says SALE. Cal looks at jackets near the window. There is no price on the blue one. Dan works at the shop and wears a name tag. Cal asks him about the price.
“Excuse me, could you tell me how much this jacket is?” says Cal. “It is sixty dollars, but it is on sale today.” says Dan. “Could you tell me how much it is with the sale?” says Cal.
